title_en: A Fluffy Cloud Weighs as Much as 100 Elephants #Shorts
desc_en:
A cumulus cloud about 1 km on each side holds roughly 0.5 g of water per cubic metre, which adds up to about 500,000 kg, around the weight of 100 elephants. It stays up because the droplets are tiny and spread far apart.

Sources: USGS Water Science School; EarthDate; Smithsonian How Things Fly.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
